title: Ganzhou, the great Buddha
place: Ganzhou (Campichu), about 1274: many monasteries and great reclining figures of the Buddha (Polo, Book 1 ch. 44).

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed. (Project Gutenberg #10636); Claude with ChatGPT (text only), 2026-11-26
findings: Polo: idols 'a good ten paces', of wood, clay or stone, gilded; 'The great idols... lie at length', with figures paying homage around them; also three Christian churches; Maffeo and Marco stayed a year.
The Great Buddha Temple in Zhangye (1098): a gilded clay reclining Buddha about 35 m long in a timber hall.

landmarks.label: great reclining Buddha
landmarks.note: a huge reclining figure along the back wall of the temple hall

cells.action: The Polos step into a dim timber temple hall where a huge gilded clay Buddha lies along the back wall, disciple figures standing behind it.

where.marco: the young man in white, in front

sees.buddha: across the back of the frame

cells.action: Marco looks up at the calm painted face of the Buddha, tiny beside it.
Monks in robes light lamps and bow before the figure.
Niccolò and Maffeo stand quietly, hats in hand, watching the monks.
